data.graph_definition: One node for each of the76 observed protein C-alpha coordinates in the specified chain/model,with all nodes retained. Uniform edge weight1 iff0<Euclidean distance<=the candidate radius. Self-edges are absent. The unnormalized Kirchhoff matrix is degree diagonal minus adjacency. The radii are prespecified sensitivity settings for this computational comparison,not experimentally calibrated interactions.
data.mode_policy: Use the complete spectrum. A numerical zero satisfies abs(eigenvalue)<=1e-8;positive means>1e-8. A candidate is eligible for the stated single-connected-network interpretation only if exactly one zero mode remains. The smallest positive eigenvalue is still reported for any candidate,including disconnected networks,but must not be reinterpreted as a global whole-chain internal mode there.
data.variance_comparison: Report modal_variance_ratio_C_over_B as the variance of the normalized softest internal mode under candidate_C divided by that under candidate_B,using the same unit spring/thermal factor so variance is proportional to1/lambda. Return null if either is ineligible. This compares their mathematical modal amplitudes,not the same eigenvector or measured residue fluctuations.
data.research_scope: A coarse-grained model applicability and sensitivity calculation on the exact historical coordinate inventory. Neither graph connectivity nor a soft eigenmode proves real conformational motion or predicts an experimental pathway. No sequence,structure modification or laboratory action is requested.

source_provenance.method_read_scope: Original paper Systems and Methods GNM subsection:alpha-carbon nodes,uniform-contact Kirchhoff definition;connected graph rankN-1;Figure1 and discussion of disconnected networks producing additional zero eigenvalues.
source_provenance.software_read_scope: Kirchhoff construction and calculation of modes;by-default trivial modes are omitted,so this audit explicitly requires the complete spectrum.
source_provenance.data_status: Authentic complete historical1UBQ PDB bytes unchanged. Radii,unit weights and numerical zero tolerance are declared analysis conventions;no observed dynamics or new experimental data are fabricated.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
